description:
In his 601st career start, Carey Price stood on the brink of hockey history, needing just one win to surpass the legendary Jacques Plante as the Montreal Canadiens' all-time leader in victories. The stage was set at the Bell Centre, where Price would deliver an extraordinary performance, making a series of crucial saves throughout the night. Early in the game, Price was tested as Andreas Athanasiou found himself on a breakaway, but the Canadiens' netminder stood tall, denying the scoring opportunity. In the second period, with the game still scoreless, Price showcased his brilliance by stopping a shot from the point followed up by an exceptional pad save on the rebound, denying the opposition a valuable lead. When another Detroit Red Wings breakaway threatened, Price came up with a jaw-dropping left pad save, frustrating Tyler Bertuzzi's deke attempt and preserving his team's chances. When the final buzzer sounded, Price had made 20 saves on 21 shots, securing his 315th career victory and etching his name in Canadiens history as the franchise's all-time wins leader.
